findings.title: CISA ICS Advisory ICSA-26-300-01 (EPICS Base)
findings.summary_md: CISA published advisory ICSA-26-300-01 on October 27, 2026, covering CVE-2026-114595 through CVE-2026-114598 in EPICS Base 7.0.10 and earlier. The advisory recommends updating to version 7.0.11 and notes the vulnerabilities were reported by Shubham Raj of Cipher / Causal Security.

findings.title: AI agent finds four severe bugs in EPICS control software
findings.summary_md: The Register reported on October 27, 2026 that Causal Security's autonomous AI agent Cipher independently discovered and validated all four EPICS Base vulnerabilities in under four hours. The piece confirms CISA's advisory and the critical 9.8 CVSS integer overflow (CVE-2026-114595).
